Grouping table from a RAMClustR result

ramclustr_to_grouping.Rd

Grouping table from a RAMClustR result

Usage

ramclustr_to_grouping(RC)

Arguments

RC

Output of RAMClustR::ramclustR(), run on the same feature table as MS1Match (e.g. the xcms object). RC$frt then has the same RT unit as that table, i.e. seconds, and is used as it is.

Value

See prepare_grouping_table. Features with featclus = 0 (not clustered) get group = NA.
